[P2] Document evidence for the simulated AgentCore behavior

CONTRIBUTING rule 6 requires evidence for external behavior or an explicit `unverified` label in the PR description. This fixture assumes per-session filesystem isolation, while the forwarder assumes AgentCore's session-header mapping. The description provides neither supporting evidence nor that label; local runs and mutation checks cannot validate those service assumptions. Return to the test-design phase and cite documentation or real-service evidence, or mark both assumptions `unverified` so the test's validation limits are explicit.
